meta.name: ip
meta.description:
IP address utilities — geolocation, subnet scanning, port discovery.
Zero barrier — use with x-cmd or curl + standard networking tools.
Use for "ip", "geolocation", "subnet", "port scan", "network".

copy.tagline: 查询IP归属地、扫描子网和端口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速获取IP信息或扫描网络端口
copy.tagline_en: Look up IP geolocation, scan subnets and ports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick IP info or network port scanning

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以查询 IP 地址的地理位置、扫描子网中的活跃主机、发现开放端口，以及列出本机 IP 地址。
howto.when: 当你提到“IP”、“地理位置”、“子网”、“端口扫描”等关键词，或要求查询某个 IP 地址的信息时触发。

say.note: 返回该 IP 的地理位置信息。
对该子网进行 ICMP ping 扫描。

say.text: 对 localhost 做端口扫描
say.note: 扫描本机的 TCP 开放端口。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can look up IP geolocation, scan subnets for active hosts, discover open ports, and list local IP addresses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "ip", "geolocation", "subnet", "port scan", or ask for information about a specific IP address.

say_en.note: Returns geolocation data for that IP.
Performs an ICMP ping sweep on that subnet.
Scans open TCP ports on the local machine.
